verification.method: local deterministic 10M ID uniqueness run using published generator axes and ID formula
notes: 10,000,000-ID uniqueness PASS was executed against the published V6.1 deterministic axis formula before the prefix-only V6.1.1 ID rename.
The V6.1.1 semantic-diversity update does not change the ID input tuple or deterministic axis dimensions, so the uniqueness result remains applicable.
The 10M corpus is generated on demand as streaming shards; it is not stored as a multi-gigabyte Git object.
